data.body:
fix-bug:investigation (2026-06-03)

STALENESS VERDICT: HOOK ALREADY IMPLEMENTED — ONE VIOLATION REMAINS

Existing artifacts: Hook .claude/hooks/pre-commit/check-script-dir-pattern.sh (109 lines, references bug 8229 in header); Registration .pre-commit-config.yaml id=script-dir-pattern-check (files: ^plugins/dso/.*\.sh$, 10s timeout); Test tests/scripts/test-check-script-dir-pattern.sh (7 test cases, ALL PASS).

Design decision: sibling (NOT extending check-plugin-self-ref.sh). One-concern-per-hook convention followed. check-plugin-self-ref.sh has zero bypass; check-script-dir-pattern.sh has suppression mechanism (# script-dir-pattern-ok: <rationale> on same line) for legitimately plugin-internal scripts.

CURRENT VIOLATIONS AUDIT: One violation found.
File: plugins/dso/scripts/validate.sh:96
Content: REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
Classification: NEEDS-FIX
Rationale: else-branch fallback when git fails; validate.sh uses REPO_ROOT for all checks (cd, scan, config read). No suppression marker. All other SCRIPT_DIR/.. occurrences assign to CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/PLUGIN_ROOT/_PLUGIN_DIR — not caught by hook (correct scoping).

Canonical fix for validate.sh:96: Replace silent fallback with: echo "ERROR: cannot resolve REPO_ROOT" >&2; exit 1

RED TEST PLAN: Already implemented in tests/scripts/test-check-script-dir-pattern.sh — 7 cases all pass: (1) anti-pattern staged -> hook exits 1, (2) suppression marker -> exits 0, (3) canonical pattern -> exits 0, (4) brace-variant -> exits 1, (5) default-assignment variant -> exits 1, (6) pattern in comment -> exits 0, (7) non-plugin script -> exits 0.

REMAINING WORK: (1) Fix validate.sh:96 — 3-line change. (2) Close ticket. Scope ~15 min. Feasibility: HIGH.
